Definition: a gem supposed to be jasper (from the resemblance in name)
BiblicalUsage: Yashphêh is a gem of the breastpiece, set in the fourth row with the beryl and the onyx. The lexicon takes it for the jasper, and Ezekiel names the jasper among the stones that covered the king of Tyre in Eden.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the stones of the breastpiece are the tribes made beautiful, and jasper is one of the colours God chose.
